verdict.rationale: GoDaddy publishes machine-readable OpenAPI specs (Domains v1/v2/v3, Commerce) and copy-paste runnable examples, including curl snippets and an end-to-end workflow in curl, Node, Python and Go. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive, in-browser API explorer or try-it console, so only the reference-plus-examples part of the story is delivered. Missing for 10: an interactive API explorer or try-it console, in-browser execution of examples, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Domains v3 OpenAPI spec — machine-readable Domains contract
